conditions: Applies to the Python 3.13.0 Language Reference.
limitations: The asserted rule applies to a saved exception and an executed control transfer out of the active finally clause. A break or continue confined to a loop inside that clause is outside the assertion.

triggers: Reevaluate controlling source revisions, errata, or material contrary evidence.

statement: The Python 3.13.0 reference describes discarding a saved exception when an executed return, break, or continue transfers control out of the active finally clause.
